notes.title: Space Ops: Reloaded - epic content update is right here, right now!
notes.content:
Epic co-op shooter in VR - Space Ops previously released on Steam and Viveport received its second and biggest free content update. Meet Space Ops: Reloaded!

Space Ops: Reloaded contains:

New content for challenge mode: 
  * Level difficulty increases with player level
  * 2 new maps for single player
  * 2 new co-op maps
  * 2 new maps for competitive 1 vs 1 play

New content for survival mode: 
  * 1 new map

Brand new mode - special operations:
* 5 levels to complete in single player or co-op mode.

New side missions:
Earn rewards after completing side missions in every game mode.

New enemy types

Significant optimization to increase performance on low settings.

notes.title: BEST CO-OP JOURNEY SPACE OPS VR RECEIVED GRAND CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Immersive VR FPS Space Ops VR previously released on Steam and Viveport received it’s biggest Major Update so far! Best VR co-op experience was developed by DevCube Studio and published by Fibrum this May and since it’s release Space Ops reaches first big milestone. 

Major content update contains:
- Brand new Survival mode with 2 maps
- New enemy types
- Game performance was significantly increased
- New reloading and handling systems for light weapons
- All enemies now have critical zones that can be easily targeted to do more damage
- Enemies spawn is now random 
- WW Leaderboards and post-battle statistics

notes.title: Content update is here! Daily quests, in-game store and much more!
Space Ops - First Update Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34937753/5b30fe6fc22bf03e29cca109bf2731586000728b.png[/img]

[b]Attention players![/b]

We’ve got some great news for you, the first update patch for Space Ops is almost ready, and we’re aiming to release the patch sometime next week.

So, let’s dive into the heart of the upcoming update and look at what it will include!

Firstly, and most importantly, we know that a lot of players have had issues with camera shake and getting VR sickness due to it, so we have added an option for you to entirely disable this in the game’s preferences menu.

For the players that have slower computers, we’ve added a new automatic graphics quality setting that will improve your performance.

And our third important feature is a much improved AI which means the enemies will be a lot bolder and more active! 

This is just the announcement of the main changes of the upcoming patch, and the full list of changes will be published soon!

notes.title: Space Ops FAQs
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34937753/81b0f854d0e02bc101bb76a3f25badf8da8bed08.png[/img]

[h1]Game FAQs[/h1]

[b]Q. Will I be playing against other players?[/b]
A. Only indirectly. The main challenge in SpaceOps is to clear the map before the opposing team, the opposing team will consist of either players or bots, either player(s) or re-runs of previous players who completed that map, and all opponents in the map will be AI controlled.

[b]Q. Can I choose to play against a bot, even if other players are available?[/b]
A. Yes, it is entirely your choice whether you want to play against other players or the recorded sessions.

[b]Q. How many players can I play with?[/b]
A. You can either play solo or in a team of two. If you play on your own, the competing team will also be a single player, and if you play in a team of two, the competing team will consist of two players.

[b]Q. What do I fight against in the game?[/b]
A. Player(s) will fight against a mixture of alien monsters and robots. At the very end of the map, the player(s) will face off against the map’s boss.

[b]Q. In 2 player mode, will I be able to invite a friend to join me, or are the match-ups entirely random?[/b]
A. Pairing in a 2 team match with other people is up to you, you can choose to play randomly, or invite a friend to join you.

[b]Q. How many different maps will I be able to play through?[/b]
A. There are 4 different maps, each of them in a different environment with different challenges.

[b]Q. In what ways can I customize my character?[/b]
A. You can customize the armor pieces, emotes and color scheme of your character

[b]Q. Will there be microtransactions in this game?[/b]
A. Rejoice, this game will not have microtransactions. 

[b]Q. How many weapons can I choose from?[/b]
A. There will be 6 weapons and several grenades for you to choose from, each of them offering different gameplay and a different experience.

[h1]VR FAQs[/h1]

[b]Q. Do I need a VR headset to play this game?[/b]
A. Yes. We may introduce a non-VR mode in the future, but for now, this game is only for VR.

[b]Q. Which VR headsets are officially supported by Space Ops?[/b]
A. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. You can also play the game on any headset that supports Windows Mixed Reality.

[b]Q. I’ve never used a VR headset before, do you have any tips for me?[/b]
A. If you have never used a VR headset before, you will not know how your body may respond to it. Always try and play the game sitting down at first. If you begin to experience nausea first try to use the teleportation system instead of the smooth motion and see if that helps. If it does not please pause the game (no need to take the headset off yet) and try to collect yourself, if you feel better after about 10 seconds, then you can continue playing. If you still feel bad, shut down the headset, take it off, and take a short break, only return to SpaceOps when you are feeling better again. This is not an uncommon reaction to playing VR games, and in most cases, with patience players can overcome the initial VR sickness and play without problems.


[h1]Technical FAQs[/h1]

[b]Q. Do you have a Discord server that I can join to talk to other Space Ops players?[/b]
A. Yes, you can join us here: https://discord.gg/nysNqDA 

[b]Q. Does the game support WMR?[/b]
A. You can switch to the WMR version in your Steam library. All you need to do is right click no Space Ops VR in your library, then navigate to properties https://gyazo.com/4f15077a77732cacb59fa2aa62f2876a, then BETAS https://gyazo.com/cb44c1aea9fe9bbbfe7e8efc79d961e9, and finally select the WMR version from the drop down menu https://gyazo.com/b5dd774fead8d0fc6a0ca6d48a921aef.

notes.title: Suit up for Boot Camp with Space Ops VR
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34937753/629a11abc65e6796842147abc7d8548b3b614c9f.png[/img]

[b]Moscow, Russia, May 9, 2019[/b] - International VR publisher and developer FIBRUM have announced today the release date for their virtual reality cooperative shooter, Space Ops VR. Players will be able to join the Space Ops and participate in their challenging training regimen on May 30th. The game will distribute through Steam and is playable across a variety of headset and controllers including the Vive, Oculus, and Windows Mixed Reality VR systems.

Space Ops VR puts you in the shoes of an enlistee of the Space Ops, an elite corps of first responders that guard perilous deep-space expeditions. To keep themselves sharp, the Space Ops practice in cutting-edge simulations and compete to be the most efficient soldiers this side of the galaxy. Space Ops VR’s scenarios can be played solo or cooperatively in score-based PvP mode that features leaderboards and a skill-based matchmaking system.

The release date trailer showcases Space Ops VR’s expansive arsenal as well as the tactics you’ll employ against the hostile creatures you train against. Unique to the game is a special tactical teleportation system that combines teleportation and a dodge maneuver to help you get a leg up on your foes, but misuse can also put you at a disadvantage. 

[b]Space Ops VR Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Extended coop experience
[*] Advanced skill-based matchmaking 
[*] Score based PvE/PvP gameplay
[*] Basic training and SANDBOX mode for the beginners
[*] Unique futuristic weapons, with different damage types such as Kinetic, Beam, and Plasma. 
[*] Tons of grenades and gadgets to send your foes flying and make the enemies wet themselves 
[*] Customizable characters 
[*] Unique teleportation system to help you save your soul - or doom you - depending on the decisions you make[/list]

[b]Supporting Assets and Links
[/b][list]
[*] Reddit https://www.reddit.com/r/Space_Ops/
[*] FB https://www.facebook.com/fibrumglobal
[*] Twitter https://twitter.com/FibrumVR
[*] Discord https://discord.gg/nysNqDA
[*] Press Kit https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_WfoBrhcYrJOVcFwIiJ9FF9wV8uhK6f9[/list]

[b]About FIBRUM[/b]
Fibrum was founded in 2013 as a cardboard-like Fibrum Pro headset manufacturer and VR content developer and publisher. Currently, the company has shipped 4 apps for Oculus Store mobile for GearVR and Oculus GO. The latest company's app Desirium is a large-scale product with more than 10 various games and experiences included. More than 30 apps are also available for cardboard-like headsets. As part of the DEVCUBE STUDIO project, FIBRUM acts as the publisher for Space Ops VR on all platforms

[b]About DEVCUBE STUDIO[/b]
DEVCUBE STUDIO – are a young and dynamic company. We have built a team of professionals to create unique and innovative products. Each of our experts has over ten years of experience in the IT-sphere.
